top_choice_rationale: P001 (GLP-1: Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) is a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain, from the gut incretin physiology to the identity of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and receptor biology, validated by large randomized outcome trials. It changed its field in a discernible way. The Mojsov versus Habener priority question is unresolved, but the citation can rest on identification of the active form rather than priority, and no award is clearly worse than this achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no credited name on P001 is a documented collaborator. Disclosed co-authorship with Per Svenningsson and one paper with Abdel El Manira, neither a candidate.
